founderAbout.title: About Vikram Chopra
founderAbout.description: Co-founder of Cars24, building across India, the UAE and Australia. Rethinking car ownership and company design through AI and Flatland.
paragraphs: My ambition is to build Cars24 into a $100 billion company from India, with people who think and act like founders.
At Cars24, we are building for the whole journey of car ownership: buying, selling, financing and everything that follows. We now operate in India, the UAE and Australia.

I co-founded Cars24 because I believed the internet would transform every category, including cars. We began by approaching car owners at a petrol pump and finding buyers through WhatsApp. Buying or selling something as important as a car should not require you to take a leap of faith.

AI has made the ambition much bigger. I believe it will transform companies more deeply than the internet did: what they can build, how fast they learn, and how far they can reach. India built software for the world. I want us to help build the next generation of global consumer companies from India.

I’m learning this by building AI agents myself. It has made me question habits I accumulated over a decade: how we organise work, how decisions get made, and how much time a hard problem should take to solve.

At Cars24, we are rebuilding both the ownership experience and the company behind it. We call our way of working Flatland: no traditional titles or hierarchy, with people organised around problems to solve. I want hundreds of people to make real decisions, take responsibility for the outcome, challenge my thinking, and build things I could never have imagined myself.

I keep building because I enjoy it. Learning a new skill, finding a better way, discovering that something I thought was beyond me is now possible. AI has given me more of that feeling than anything since the internet.
